input: Audit the subscriptions on my business credit card

gold.taskDescription: Review all recurring subscription charges on a business credit card to identify, evaluate, and take action on them.

questions.title: Which credit card or bank account are we auditing?
questions.description: Identify the specific card or account (e.g., Amex, Chase Ink, Capital One Spark) that holds the subscriptions.

questions.title: How far back should the audit look?
questions.description: Determine the time period to review, such as the last 3 months, 6 months, or a full year.

questions.title: What is the main goal of this audit?
questions.description: Clarify the primary intent — cutting costs, finding unused services, organizing records, or preparing for tax purposes.

questions.title: Do you have a rough monthly budget target in mind?
questions.description: Understand if there is a spending ceiling or savings goal the user wants to hit after the audit.

questions.title: Who else has access to charge subscriptions on this card?
questions.description: Find out if team members, departments, or vendors can add charges, which affects the scope of the review.

questions.title: Are there categories of subscriptions to prioritize first?
questions.description: Identify if certain types — such as SaaS tools, media, or utilities — should be reviewed before others.

questions.title: What should happen to subscriptions flagged as unnecessary?
questions.description: Clarify the desired next step — cancel immediately, escalate for approval, or just flag for review.
